description: Establish which regions of the genome are accessible in parental Hs27 fibroblasts, as a baseline for interpreting the transcription factor perturbation experiments carried out in this cell line. Chromatin accessibility was profiled by ATAC-seq in three biological replicates and reported as aligned reads and as genome-wide coverage normalized for sequencing depth.
